body.objective: Construct the generic-ell axial Schwarzschild curvature and metric asymptotic operator needed for a modewise finite-radial-pairing theorem.
body.stop_condition: Freeze Schwarzschild M=1, axial parity, ell>=2, real omega!=0, conjugate-frequency sphere-integrated F^v, and the formal/polyhomogeneous radial class. Import BH2_GENERAL_L_STRUCTURAL, BH2C_SYMBOLIC_INDICIAL, BH2C_METRIC_ALL_ORDERS, BH2C_SYMBOLIC_FLUX_RADIATION_CLASS, BH2_OMEGA_ZERO and BH_ENDPOINT_NONSELECTION_ASSEMBLY by exact hashes. Over Q(Lambda,omega,M), Lambda=ell(ell+1), derive curvature-carrier and metric systems, characteristic rates and powers, recurrence pivots, resonance/log conditions and the exact exceptional set. Reproduce ell=2 and independently recompute ell=3. Stop with either the finite-depth/all-orders recurrence theorem required by the current or the first exact ell-dependent obstruction.
body.current_gate: Generic-ell axial asymptotic recurrence and exceptional locus
body.forbid: no sampled-ell theorem; no polar claim; no full phase space, Hilbert norm, scattering, QNM, stability or particle claim; no omega=0 inclusion; no exponent-only inference called a literal current coefficient
body.resource_hint: Reuse bh2_general_l_structural and bh2c_metric_all_orders; keep Lambda symbolic and use exact recurrence/pivot algebra.
